label: SEOUL GUIDE
title: Fermented skincare, explained
dek: Why Korean labels love the word 'ferment'.

points.t: Ingredients processed with yeast or bacteria, like in food fermentation.
A food culture of kimchi and soy sauce made the idea feel natural.
Lighter, more absorbable textures and gentle results.
Look for names like galactomyces or bifida ferment.
